exactSource.controllingText: Canonical record families are the sole substantive authority. A stage field that concerns canonical data is exactly one of:

Canonical record families are the sole substantive authority for canonical project data. Stage-data fields that correspond to canonical records may contain only: (a) pre-acceptance proposal payloads, (b) immutable canonical ID references, or (c) application-recomputed summaries. Duplicated substantive canonical values in stage data are prohibited. Any summary/reference mismatch fails integrity validation and cannot be resolved by choosing whichever copy is convenient.

exactSource.controllingText: Repository governance MUST maintain one machine-readable closed-loop-normative-requirements/1 manifest generated from and reviewed against the controlling specification. It assigns a stable NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT_ID to every distinct normative requirement, prohibition, invariant, field contract, operation contract, negative case, regression obligation, deployment obligation, and definition-of-done metric. Each entry records the controlling text location, responsible implementation owner, schema or registry entry, deterministic and semantic test IDs, mutation-test IDs, required browser or physical-device proof, acceptance-report field, and current disposition.

exactSource.controllingText: The current registries are closed-loop-json-selector/1 and closed-loop-xml-selector/1. closed-loop-json-selector/1 MUST support at least: the root `$`; child access by identifier name and by single-quoted bracket name; nonnegative array index; and the wildcard `*` over object values and array elements. Selection order is document order. Recursive descent, filters, unions, slices, and script expressions are excluded from version 1. closed-loop-xml-selector/1 MUST support at least: absolute child-element paths from the document root; the element wildcard `*`; 1-based positional index predicates; attribute access `@name`; and `text()` value extraction. All other axes, predicates, and functions are excluded from version 1. A proposition that cannot be faithfully expressed within these registered subsets is not natively representable and routes externally.
232. Selector and regex constructs outside closed-loop-json-selector/1, closed-loop-xml-selector/1, and closed-loop-regex/1 fail Stage 06 ingestion.
